audience: site reliability engineers who investigate logs and check alerts in Axiom

useCases.title: Query logs for errors
useCases.text: List the datasets and their fields, then run an APL query on them. Results over 150,000 characters are cut and marked.

useCases.title: Review which monitors fired
useCases.text: List the monitors with their queries, thresholds and state. Read the history of one monitor to see its notifications or runs in a time range.

useCases.title: Open a team dashboard
useCases.text: List the dashboards and open one to read its charts and queries. List the saved APL queries to reuse them.

useCases.title: Mark a deployment on the charts
useCases.text: List the annotations of a dataset in a time range to check for an existing marker. Add an annotation for the deployment; existing annotations do not change.
